insights: Mathlib provides variance_sum (full double sum ∑ᵢ∑ⱼ Cov) but not the symmetrised diagonal/off-diagonal split; the gap is pure bookkeeping symmetry handled by Finset.sum_nbij with Prod.swap.
The diagonal/off-diagonal split is exactly the decomposition exposing the dependent-CLT long-run variance σ²∞ = Var[X₁] + 2∑_{k≥1}Cov[X₁,X_{k+1}].
covariance_self identifies Cov[X,X] with Var[X]; covariance_comm gives off-diagonal symmetry.
nextSteps: Add summable-autocovariance hypothesis to prove Var[Sₙ]/n → σ²∞ for stationary sequences.
